text.tspan: Five processes transform user requests and GitHub data into stored history and repository reports.
Account records, password hashes and roles
Repository, author, commit, file and change records
Repository metadata, saved SHAs and checkpoints
Repository metadata, commits and modified files
Changed file paths, blob references and cached source
Analysis status, thresholds and all function scores
Existing analysis runs for the selected engine
Source-blob content when absent from cache
Repository developers and candidate fixing commits
New reports and assignment / progress / fix events
Reports, assignments and prior resolution events
Commit history, file changes and developer contributions
Stored measurements, coverage and warning predicates
Bug events, current status and resolution duration
D2 repositories, developers, commits, files, changes, import_pages, source_blobs
D3 analysis_runs, measurements D4 bugs, bug_events
Repeated store / GitHub symbols identify the same store or entity. Legacy scans / warnings are omitted from this current workflow.
